title: Unit 14 Consolidation: Visual Storytelling, Perspective & Time

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can link immediate sequences using amint, mihelyt, and alighogy... máris.
I can represent parallel actions and duration with miközben, mialatt, and eközben.
I can use iterative temporal conjunctions (valahányszor, ahányszor csak) and visual terminology in reviews.
